purpose: Map Qlib's experiment-recorder reproducibility model (qrun config + recorder rerun) into QuantOS runtime run/replay semantics.

qlib_source.reproducibility_model: rerun a frozen qrun YAML against the same qlib data directory; recorder metrics/params are re-logged under a new mlflow run id

replay_semantics.same_input_same_hash: rescheduling with the same frozen input must reproduce the same input_hash and deduplicate artifacts instead of creating new physical copies
replay_semantics.artifact_dedup: physical artifact count stays at 1 across replays, matching quantos-runtime kernel recovery semantics
replay_semantics.evidence_locatable: every evidence ref must resolve to a recorded artifact manifest, not to an external mlflow run id
replay_semantics.contrast_with_qlib: qlib reruns mint a new mlflow run id per execution; QuantOS deduplicates by content hash and idempotency key

boundary_notes: this sample documents semantics only; no qlib workflow code runs inside quantos-runtime
R03 research orchestration already enforces stable input hash and locatable evidence; this sample proves the qlib model can be expressed inside those semantics
